caption: The peace of our Alpine village was briefly interrupted by a heavy guest from the workshop floor. A massive, industrial steel file decided to take a permanent residence in our town square. It took the collective strength of the entire village to put it in its rightful place, but they managed it with a bit of grit and a lot of teamwork.
